page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.u2i-c1m8.large is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by a 2.7 GHz Intel Xeon processor. It features 2 dedicated vCPUs and 16.0 GB of system memory, yielding a memory-to-core ratio of 8.0 GB per vCPU. The instance operates on the KVM hypervisor.

This server configuration does not include local storage, meaning all storage must be provisioned via network-attached volumes. It features a baseline network bandwidth of 2 Gbps and does not include any GPUs or complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

With a 1:8 vCPU-to-RAM ratio, this instance is designed for memory-intensive workloads that do not require high compute density. The dedicated CPU allocation ensures consistent processing performance, though the baseline network bandwidth of 2 Gbps and the lack of local storage represent potential bottlenecks for data-heavy transfers.

The ecs.u2i-c1m8.large is suited for memory-optimized workloads such as small-scale caching layers, lightweight databases, in-memory data processing, and enterprise applications requiring a larger memory footprint relative to compute capacity.
